description: I want to learn about mars
summary: Mission Memory is an interactive digital platform, which tells about the equipment of NASA that has been abandoned on the Moon and on Mars. We created a design for a learning website where users would be able to view the abandoned landers, rovers, scientific instruments and other equipment used in various missions. Users would be introduced to the purpose of each equipment, achievements of it, and importance in space exploration. The platform consists of interactive maps, images, timelines of the missions, little stories and quizzes. Mission Memory addresses NASA's challenge by making their abandoned equipment interesting and understandable. This is particularly important since the equipment we refer to is not just some abandoned objects, but actually the product of human ingenuity and milestones in the history of space research.
details:
My project, Mission Memory, is a website that teaches people about the machines left behind on Mars. Visitors can explore the machines, read about them, learn interesting facts, and take a quiz.

The goal of my project is to help people learn more about Mars and its missions. It also helps students understand how machines are used to explore space.

I created a website using HTML and used PowerPoint for my presentation.

My project is creative because it works like a digital museum where people can learn by exploring. I wanted to make it simple, interesting, and easy to use.
